content.text: Linked Story: CREWCMBR-668

Precondition: A trip exists where an involuntary event replaces a leg. The replacement leg has isOriginal=false (non-original) and is a paying flying leg. Out of Scope: LRO, RRO, Guarantees, Special Rules.
TEST STEPS
Step
Action
Test Data
Expected Result
Set up a trip V0 with an original flying leg (isOriginal=true) and trigger an involuntary Save and Replace that replaces it with a new paying flying leg in V1
V0: DAL->HOU, isOriginal=true, legType=Flying. V1: DAL->AUS, isOriginal=false, changeType=INVOL, legType=Flying
Trip V1 is created with the new leg having isOriginal=false
Trigger the LCO Lambda to process V1 of the trip
Involuntary trip payload V1 with new non-original flying leg
Lambda is invoked successfully without errors
Verify the LCO lambda identifies the flown leg as non-original and the change as involuntary
isOriginal=false, changeType=INVOL, legType=Flying (paying leg)
Lambda classifies the leg as eligible for LCO override code P
Verify the LCO code assigned to the leg in the lambda output
Flown leg: DAL->AUS, isOriginal=false, INVOL, paying flying leg
lcoCode = P
Confirm the DB update lambda persists lcoCode = P for the leg in DynamoDB
Lambda output payload with lcoCode=P on the new involuntary non-original leg
DynamoDB record shows lcoCode = P on the applicable leg
